chat.responseFormat.label: Response format
chat.input.channelUnavailable: This channel is inactive or unavailable. Activate it in Settings or select another channel.
chat.input.publicReplyHint: Public reply to the selected comment. This is not a direct message.
chat.input.selectCommentHint: Select the comment you want to reply to.
chat.input.noCommentHint: No replyable comment is available. Open the original post to reply.
chat.input.callHint: Start an outbound call. Your message is the opening greeting; consent and phone checks apply.
chat.input.internalHint: Internal agent chat. Messages here do not contact the customer.
chat.input.interventionHint: Send a team intervention through the selected channel.
chat.input.channelLoadError: Unable to verify the conversation channel. Retry before sending.
chat.input.whatsappAudioHint: Audio is requested. When the WhatsApp messaging window is closed, a compatible template may be delivered instead.
chat.input.doNotCall: No call started. This lead is on the do-not-call list. Outbound calls are blocked.
chat.input.callOptOut: No call started. This lead has explicitly opted out of outbound calls. Outbound calls are blocked.
chat.input.phoneRequired: No call started. Add a valid international phone number, including the country code, to the linked lead.
chat.input.leadRequired: No call started. Link this conversation to a lead with a phone number and call consent before calling.
chat.status.templateRetryUnavailable: Manual retry is unavailable for template delivery.
chat.status.audioCheckBeforeRetry: Check audio delivery status before retrying.
chat.status.approvalHint: Waiting for approval before replying to the original comment
chat.status.failedHint: Message failed to reach the server
